method: Read automatically from banks' own official pages and fee documents (Germany: Entgeltinformation under the Payment Accounts Act ZKG, Preis- und Leistungsverzeichnis; USA: fee schedules and rate pages). US baseline from FDIC National Rates and Rate Caps via FRED. Every card carries source_url and checked_at. If a source cannot be read, the card keeps the last verified values and gets status 'stale' or 'blocked' instead of a guessed number.
disclaimer: Information only, not financial advice. Conditions change; check with the bank before opening an account.

us.label: FDIC national average (all US banks)
us.source: FDIC National Rates and Rate Caps via FRED
